description: Dynamic Island-style edge panel and taskbar replacement for Windows with widgets, media controls, picture-in-picture, quick settings, and programmable panels.
notes: The official ZIP contains ShoreHue.exe at its root with README, LICENSE, and documentation files. The executable is built as a self-contained single-file .NET 10 application; the MSIX asset is not used.
The application stores its data under %LOCALAPPDATA%\ShoreHue, outside the Scoop app directory. The application's own updater is not modified.
